q: The Connes-Feldman-Weiss theorem states that for a measure-preserving action of an amenable group:
opts: It is orbit equivalent to a ℤ-action (i.e., an action of the integers)
It is orbit equivalent to every free action
exp: CFW theorem (1981): every essentially free, ergodic, measure-preserving action of a countable amenable group is orbit equivalent to an ergodic ℤ-action. This reduces the study of amenable group actions to single transformations.
